items.description: Perfecto is a web application that allows users to sell and buy used bikes, with knowledge of the sellers and buyers. Perfecto partners with Strava which gives users information about the history of the bikes for sale and build a rapport between seller and buyer. This application uses the Bike Index API.
Littera Report is a source for independent media that promotes all original content by geographic region. Site is still under development and uses Facebook, Twitter, Twilio and Twilio SMS APIs.
Honeygain is a mobile application in which users can earn money by allowing application access to user behavior. Simply download the app, turn it on, and earn!
